stories.title: “听月雅集”中秋音乐会在美国纽约举办

en.title: Mid-Autumn Music Concert "Listening to the Moon Elegant Gathering" Held in New York, USA
en.summary: The Chinese Consulate General in New York hosted the second Mid-Autumn music concert at Rockefeller Center's Rainbow Room, attended by nearly 100 Chinese expatriates and American guests.

stories.title: 专家解析中国民营企业500强报告：制造业已成为“质的引擎”

en.title: Experts Analyze China's Top 500 Private Enterprises Report: Manufacturing Has Become the "Engine of Quality"
en.summary: Manufacturing enterprises among China's top 500 private companies generate 72% of revenue and 60% of net profit with 51% of assets, contributing 71% of research and development investment.

stories.title: 中国—东盟经贸部长会议和RCEP部长级会议在菲律宾马尼拉举行

en.title: China-ASEAN Economic and Trade Ministers Meeting and RCEP Ministerial Meeting Held in Manila, Philippines
en.summary: The 25th China-ASEAN economic and trade ministers meeting took place in Manila, where officials exchanged views on global and regional economic issues, bilateral cooperation, and free trade zone development.

stories.title: 2026比利·简·金杯深圳总决赛开赛 捷克队取得开门红

en.title: 2026 Billie Jean King Cup Shenzhen Finals Begins; Czech Republic Gets Off to Winning Start
en.summary: The 2026 Billie Jean King Cup final tournament opened in Shenzhen, with the Czech Republic defeating Great Britain 2-0 in the opening match.

stories.title: 2026年国际篮联洲际杯：北京控股队不敌阿根廷博卡青年

en.title: 2026 FIBA Continental Cup: Beijing Ducks lose to Argentina's Boca Juniors
en.summary: In the opening day of the 2026 FIBA Continental Cup in Beijing, the Beijing Ducks lost 78-88 to Argentina's Boca Juniors, while Lithuania's Vilnius Rytas defeated Rwanda's RSSB Tigers 107-89.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）中国女排完胜日本 实现亚运三连冠

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: China women's volleyball team dominates Japan, achieves three consecutive Asian Games titles
en.summary: China's women's volleyball team defeated Japan 3-0 in the final of the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, securing the championship and their third consecutive Asian Games gold medal.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）综合消息：中国四将同获“三金王” 中国女排加冕亚运“十冠王”

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: Summary - Four Chinese athletes each win three golds; Chinese women's volleyball team becomes ten-time Asian Games champions
en.summary: On the third competition day of the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, 25 gold medals were awarded. Four Chinese athletes each won their third individual gold in shooting and swimming, and China's women's volleyball team defeated host Japan 3-0 to claim their tenth Asian Games gold medal.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）中国游泳队又夺4金 张展硕再现逆转好戏

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: China's swimming team claims 4 more golds; Zhang Zhanshuo produces another comeback performance
en.summary: In swimming competition at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games on September 22, six gold medals were awarded, with China's swimming team securing four golds, two silvers, and two bronzes.

en.title: "Paper Silk" Retains Its Splendor After Four Centuries
en.summary: Lianshi paper, a traditional handmade papermaking craft, is produced from bamboo fibers through a natural bleaching process and 72 artisanal techniques. Meiyutang workshop, operated by its eleventh-generation successor Deng Jinkun, remains the sole producer in the region maintaining this centuries-old papermaking tradition.

stories.title: Trump defends Iran war, touts ‘America is back’ agenda in UN speech

en.title: Trump defends Iran war, touts 'America is back' agenda in UN speech
en.summary: Donald Trump addressed the UN General Assembly, defending his Iran policy and promoting his policies as benefiting the world while claiming America's strength has been restored. His speech occurred amid ongoing conflicts across multiple regions including Ukraine, Gaza, and Yemen.

stories.title: Learning from Ukraine war, Chinese military doctors target injuries from drones

en.title: Learning from Ukraine war, Chinese military doctors target injuries from drones
en.summary: Chinese military medical experts are developing treatments for injuries common in drone warfare by studying conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East. Cranio-maxillofacial injuries have become particularly prevalent in drone-dominated conflicts, according to a senior Chinese military doctor.

stories.title: 185 Years of Private Banking Heritage, A Legacy of Forward-thinking Stewardship

en.title: 185 Years of Private Banking Heritage, A Legacy of Forward-thinking Stewardship
en.summary: The J. Safra Group marks its 185th anniversary by combining its historical banking heritage with modern strategic changes. The group acquired Saxo Bank to gain access to advanced digital capabilities for its banking operations.

stories.title: China’s Hygon moves beyond data centres with embedded processors for robotics, edge AI

en.title: China's Hygon moves beyond data centres with embedded processors for robotics, edge AI
en.summary: Chinese chipmaker Hygon launched a new series of processors designed for robotics and industrial edge devices. The processors enable local computing capabilities for factory automation and physical artificial intelligence applications.

stories.title: Some family offices eyeing Chinese investments as US-China tensions ease: report

en.title: Some family offices eyeing Chinese investments as US-China tensions ease: report
en.summary: Ultra-wealthy families from Europe, the Middle East and Africa increasingly view China as their preferred investment destination, according to a Citigroup survey of 351 family offices. The shift reflects reduced concerns about US-China geopolitical tensions.

stories.title: China’s Huawei trims mobile chip gap with Apple as Tau Scaling Law pays off: Bernstein

en.title: China's Huawei trims mobile chip gap with Apple as Tau Scaling Law pays off: Bernstein
en.summary: Huawei's new Kirin 9050 Pro smartphone processor has reduced its technological gap with Apple's chips to approximately three years, according to Bernstein analysis. The processor demonstrated competitive performance in standard processor benchmarks.

stories.title: Amazon and Shorea Capital deals underscore foreign interest in commercial property

en.title: Amazon and Shorea Capital deals underscore foreign interest in commercial property
en.summary: Foreign investors including Amazon and Singapore-based Shorea Capital are acquiring commercial real estate assets in Hong Kong, with Shorea recently purchasing The Pemberton, a mixed-use property in Sheung Wan.
